items.display_name: DECAPEPTYL LP 22.5 mg sol inj LP
DECAPEPTYL LP 3.75 mg sol inj IM

active_ingredients: valproate (sodium valproate / valproic acid depending on formulation)
contraindications: Pregnancy for migraine prophylaxis; generally avoid in pregnancy unless no alternative (high teratogenicity)
Known mitochondrial disorders caused by POLG mutations (risk of liver failure)

age_rules.pediatrics: Used in children for epilepsy; higher hepatic risk <2 years (especially polytherapy). Specialist monitoring required.

pregnancy_lactation.pregnancy: High teratogenic and neurodevelopmental risk. Avoid if possible; strict risk management if used.
pregnancy_lactation.lactation: Generally compatible with monitoring; infant sedation/bruising rare; follow local guidance.

major_interactions: Lamotrigine → ↑ lamotrigine levels (rash risk); dose adjust
Carbapenem antibiotics → reduce valproate levels (loss of seizure control)

duplicate_therapy_warnings.message: Polytherapy increases adverse-effect risk; specialist oversight.
